title: Lavender / Feeds & workers
description: The background workers that refresh the feeds, the feed downloads and the icon cache.

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: Feeds waiting for a worker. It should drain between refreshes.

panels.title: Jobs in flight
panels.description: Feeds being fetched right now.

panels.title: Workers
panels.description: Configured with FEED_WORKERS.

panels.title: Refresh failure ratio
panels.description: Share of the refresh jobs that failed.

panels.title: New articles (24h)
panels.description: Articles stored by the refreshes.

panels.title: Queue full (1h)
panels.description: Feeds that could not be queued, as the queue was full. The scheduler picks them up later.

panels.title: Feeds
panels.description: Feeds of all the users.

panels.title: Active
panels.description: Feeds that are refreshed.

panels.title: Paused
panels.description: Feeds with the automatic refresh turned off.

panels.title: With an error
panels.description: Feeds whose last refresh failed.

panels.title: Never fetched
panels.description: Active feeds that were not fetched yet.

panels.title: Oldest fetch
panels.description: How long ago the active feed that was fetched longest ago was fetched. Much longer than the refresh interval means the workers are behind.

panels.title: Jobs by result
panels.description: success, fetch_error (the feed could not be loaded), store_error, not_found (deleted while queued), cancelled (shutdown).

panels.title: Job duration percentiles
panels.description: From the start of the job to the end of the storing of the articles. A job times out at 30s.

panels.title: Queue depth and jobs in flight
Queue offers by source and result
panels.description: source: scheduler or user (a refresh by hand). result: queued, duplicate (already queued or being fetched) or full.

panels.title: Time in the queue
panels.description: How long a feed waits for a worker. It grows when there are too few workers.

panels.title: Sites with the most failed refreshes (last 24h)
panels.description: The hosts of the feeds that failed most.

panels.title: Sites that gave the most new articles (last 24h)
Downloads by result
panels.description: success, network, bad_status (not a 2xx), not_a_feed, invalid_url, cancelled.

panels.title: Download duration percentiles
panels.description: A download times out at 8s.

panels.title: Responses by HTTP status
panels.description: What the sites answer. 0 (left out) is no answer at all: a timeout or a connection error.

panels.title: Lookups by result
panels.description: hit, miss (downloaded), stale (served after a failed refresh), failed_cached, unavailable, error.
